Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP & acceptance sync

Emma — thanks for the prompt. Below is a compact MAP checkpoint covering week 6 progress, owners, and blockers. I attached the current MAP owners workbook (map-v6-owners.xlsx) and the acceptance checklist (acceptance-checklist.pdf) for your slides.

High-level status (traffic lights):
- Milestone A — Data ingestion & anonymization: GREEN. Ingestion tests passed for 95% sample set. Owner: Karthik Iyer.
- Milestone B — Embedding quality & recall: AMBER. Initial recall for the 50 test cases is at 86% vs target 92%. Owner: Marissa Cole + Research.
- Milestone C — Latency & infra SLOs: RED-light for peak tail latency (95th pct). Owner: Rishi Malhotra / Infra.

Acceptance criteria (short):
1) Latency: 95th percentile under 350ms for 2k token median requests — currently 420ms at peak.
2) Data persistence: anonymized data retention policy applied to test dataset — ✔️ completed.
3) Embedding recall: >=92% on canonical 50-case set — currently 86% (see notes).

Blockers and mitigations:
- Peak latency spike tied to KV cache miss during burst tests. Action: Rishi to deploy cache warming and tweak batching window (ETA: 48 hours).
- Recall gap likely model selection + prompt template mismatch for a specific document type (billing statements). Action: Marissa to run targeted prompt sweep and share eval artifacts by Mon 6/1.
- SSO integration for secure audit trails is partially blocked by BrightLeaf test IdP configs. Action: Karthik to run a focused IdP troubleshooting session; requesting BrightLeaf attach SAML metadata (Lauren).

Immediate action items (owners & due dates):
- R1: Rishi — cache warm + batching config change; validate with 2 load runs (due 2027-05-31).
- R2: Marissa — provide prompt sweep results + updated eval set for the 50 cases (due 2027-06-01).
- R3: Karthik — IdP troubleshooting call + sample metadata; share post-mortem (due 2027-05-30).
- R4: Vanessa — update MAP workbook and host a 30-min alignment on Mon 6/1 (calendar invite to follow).

Proposed timeline impact: if R1 & R2 succeed on schedule, we can preserve the 6/10 close but will need an accelerated acceptance run the week of 6/2. If R1 slips, we should push to 6/17 to give a full regression and infra tuning window.

Quick logistics: DocuSign pre-approval is ready; legal redlines are minimal and we can attach a conditional signature on passing acceptance.

Attachments: map-v6-owners.xlsx, acceptance-checklist.pdf (see link below)
Links: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/DL-34821

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP & acceptance sync

Vanessa / Emma — adding technical detail and concrete ask from infra side.

Short summary: the SSO issue Emma mentioned is the gating item for secure audit trails. On our side we've validated the SAML flow with a sandbox IdP, but BrightLeaf's test IdP is returning a non-standard NameID format which prevents session mapping.

What we need from BrightLeaf:
- Your test IdP metadata XML (single-file) and one sample SAML Response (anonymized) so we can reproduce mapping behavior locally.
- Confirmation which NameID attribute should map to BrightLeaf's internal user_id (email vs emp_id).

Planned steps:
1) Karthik runs a replicate with your sample SAML response and pins the assertion parsing path.
2) If mismatch, we'll add a mapping shim (small patch) and run an end-to-end ID token validation flow — estimate 8-12 hours of engineering.
3) Post-fix, we will run the security audit checklist against the mapped sessions and export logs for your compliance team.

Impact on timeline: if we get the metadata and sample by EOD 5/29, we can complete the fix and validation by 5/30 (internal release to the POC environment). If delayed, SSO gating could move the acceptance window 4-5 business days.

On the recall: Marissa — happy to pair on the prompt sweep. I recommend we run a targeted contrast set (billing statements vs clinical notes) and quantize embeddings to see if representation improves. I can carve out 2 hours Monday afternoon to iterate.

--
